rationale: The price has failed to sustain downward momentum after the entry, printing three consecutive candles that have reclaimed the $15.32 level and are testing the 9-EMA. With the price stalling at the entry point and showing a lack of follow-through toward the VWAP, the original thesis of immediate mean reversion is invalidated by the recent price action. Closing now preserves capital and avoids the risk of a breakout above the $15.36 9-EMA.
